currency.basis: Asset served live by sc.com/sg header on 2026-10-04; Commons dates the two-colour mark to 2021-02-05 with continued use.

identity.basis: Official current sc.com logo asset and live header reference; Commons corroboration.

assessment.independenceRationale: Primary observation is the official asset served by sc.com; Commons independently dates the same mark; no dependence on copies.

variant.basis: Current official variant is the two-colour ribbon; the base lightened four-colour variant is not attested on any official current surface.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Internal details preserved: rounded segment ends, the blue chevron aperture, and both detached end caps match the official source; official hex values reproduced exactly (#38D200->#38d200 serialization only).
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Source aspect preserved (69.5x109.5); uniform fit into the 162px icon area without stretching; clearances and whole-emblem fit verified in the exact 240px renders.
candidate.rationale: Colour/geometry correction to the current official mark: the base is the outdated lightened four-colour ribbon variant; the candidate reproduces the official standalone two-colour mark (#38d200/#0473ea) from the official sc.com logo SVG. Supported rebranding (2021 mark refresh, dated by Commons) plus colour correction of unattested lightened fills.
candidate.role: Standalone brand symbol (interlocking ribbon) extracted from the official full logo; wordmark lettering deliberately excluded as unsuitable text for a square standalone app icon.
transforms: Selected the four mark paths (2x #38D200, 2x #0473EA) from the official 280x110 full-logo SVG; no geometry edits.
ViewBox narrowed from 0 0 280 110 to 0 0 69.5 109.5 around the unchanged mark geometry (pure crop = translation only, no scaling of path data).

SVGO 4.1.0 on a copy with repository svgo.config.mjs: 1929 -> 1073 bytes (44.4% smaller); optimized result selected after independent working-vs-optimized render comparison showed identical appearance.
No color, path, or backdrop changes; no tracing; transparency preserved.
candidate.variant: Current official two-colour mark; the base lightened four-colour variant is not attested on any official current surface.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Base versus final differ visibly: base uses four lightened, unattested fills (#a4d09f/#77add2/#0071a9/#21a947) of the older ribbon weave; final reproduces the current official two-colour mark. This is the intended brand-currency correction, not a serialization change.

proposals.reason: Base icon is an outdated lightened four-colour variant (#a4d09f/#77add2/#0071a9/#21a947) of the Standard Chartered interlocking ribbon; the current official mark uses the brand two-colour scheme (#38D200 green / #0473EA blue) with identical ribbon geometry. This is a supported colour correction of the same organization's current mark, not a serialization-only change.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Colour correction to the current official two-colour mark (#38D200/#0473EA) replacing the outdated lightened four-colour variant; geometry/identity unchanged (same interlocking ribbon).

sources.observation: Official current full logo SVG (wordmark + standalone mark subtree, viewBox ~0 0 68 110); served from the live sc.com/sg header; sha256 75f45303a558f48d99512cc4bb53d66e76663b112802b58a29122ccf315a30d4. Receipt fetch-442ca01d95224c0bb8e6c0c43ee87b40.
Live Singapore header references the same standard-chartered-logo.svg asset; favicon shows the standalone mark.
Commons dates the two-colour mark to 2021-02-05; 'Logo only' SVG is an Inkscape crop of exactly the official URL - corroboration of currentness, not source material.
